WITH rental_payments AS (
  SELECT 
    r.rental_id,
    i.store_id,
    SUM(p.amount) AS rental_total
  FROM rental r
  JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
  JOIN payment p ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id
  GROUP BY r.rental_id, i.store_id
),
avg_rental_total AS (
  SELECT AVG(rental_total) AS avg_total
  FROM rental_payments
),
above_average_rentals AS (
  SELECT 
    rp.rental_id,
    rp.store_id,
    rp.rental_total,
    (rp.rental_total - art.avg_total) AS above_avg
  FROM rental_payments rp
  CROSS JOIN avg_rental_total art
  WHERE rp.rental_total > art.avg_total
)
SELECT 
  aar.store_id,
  SUM(aar.rental_total) AS combined_payment_total,
  AVG(aar.above_avg) AS avg_beat_by
FROM above_average_rentals aar
GROUP BY aar.store_id
ORDER BY aar.store_id
